nodes.title: [AssetMaid:metadata]
widgets_values:
# Asset Maid Comfy UI 기본 워크플로

이 워크플로는 레퍼런스가 없어도 동작하는 Anima Base T2I 기본 골격입니다.

Asset Maid Workflow Bridge는 현재 UI 워크플로를 Comfy UI 실행 그래프로 자동 동기화합니다. Queue 실행이나 별도 API JSON 내보내기는 필요하지 않습니다.

## 예약 노드

| 예약 제목 | 플러그인이 전달하거나 읽는 값 |
|---|---|
| `[AssetMaid:positive]` | Anima 긍정 프롬프트 |
| `[AssetMaid:negative]` | Anima 부정 프롬프트 |
| `[AssetMaid:size]` | 요청 이미지 너비와 높이 |
| `[AssetMaid:reference-enabled]` | 예약 IMAGE 노드가 최종 출력 경로에 연결되고 입력이 있으면 `true`, 그 밖에는 `false` |
| `[AssetMaid:seed-progress]` | 생성 시드 |
| `[AssetMaid:vanilla-progress]` | KSampler 실행 진행률 |
| `[AssetMaid:output]` | 최종 생성 이미지 |

`[AssetMaid:outfit-reference]`와 `[AssetMaid:character-reference]`는 각각 선택된 의상 이미지와 캐릭터 크롭 이미지를 받습니다. 두 슬롯은 기본 `EmptyImage`와 `PreviewImage`로 연결되어 레퍼런스가 없어도 오류 없이 실행됩니다. 레퍼런스가 있으면 플러그인이 실행 그래프의 슬롯을 기본 `LoadImage`로 자동 변환하므로 별도 노드 설정 없이 미리보기에 표시됩니다. `[AssetMaid:reference-enabled]`는 생성 경로와 분리된 기본 `PrimitiveBoolean`이며 레퍼런스 IMAGE 노드가 최종 출력 경로에 연결될 때만 `true`가 됩니다. 기본 미리보기 가지에서는 `false`를 유지하므로 생성 결과에 직접 영향을 주지 않습니다.

모델, LoRA, Steps, CFG, Sampler, Scheduler, VAE 및 후처리는 사용자가 자유롭게 편집할 수 있습니다. 위 예약 노드의 Title은 변경하지 않아야 합니다.

```assetmaid
{
  "schema": "asset-maid.comfy-ui-workflow",
  "version": 1,
  "workflowId": "asset-maid-comfy-ui-workflow-v1",
  "revision": 1,
  "provider": "comfy-ui",
  "promptDialect": "anima",
  "bindings": {
    "positive": "[AssetMaid:positive]",
    "negative": "[AssetMaid:negative]",
    "size": "[AssetMaid:size]",
    "referenceEnabled": "[AssetMaid:reference-enabled]",
    "seedProgress": "[AssetMaid:seed-progress]",
    "vanillaProgress": "[AssetMaid:vanilla-progress]",
    "output": "[AssetMaid:output]",
    "outfitReference": "[AssetMaid:outfit-reference]",
    "characterReference": "[AssetMaid:character-reference]"
  }
}
```

presets.name: 삽화
presets.instruction: Write Camera once per illustration and only for camera position, one validated scene or body reference, and viewing direction. Use a scene reference when uncertain. Never repeat placement, action, Interaction, pose, body state, fluid, clothing, emotion, location content, or past events.

presets.name: pov 연출
presets.instruction: Show the scene through the persona's eyes, maintaining their eye level, gaze direction, and viewing distance. Never switch to an external or another actor's viewpoint. In the persona's pose description, include only visible hand and arm actions in the current image or panel, including contact, support, or object handling. Keep these actions consistent with the first-person view; leave the description empty when no hands or arms are visible or no action needs clarification. Do not describe the persona's face, appearance, clothing, whole-body pose, or unseen body parts. Frame other present actors and their interactions clearly within a plausible field of view.

presets.name: 다인 연출
presets.instruction: Compose all actors confirmed present at the depicted time and place together, including quiet observers and non-human participants. Preserve established presence within a continuous scene unless departure is indicated. Widen the view or adjust spacing and depth to keep everyone distinguishable and interactions readable. Do not split the scene solely because of actor count, combine separate scenes, or add participants based only on mentions or candidate records.

presets.name: 카툰 연출
presets.instruction: Render each requested illustration as one coherent manga page. Let the scene's action, emotion, timing, and reveal drive bold variation in panel scale, shape, overlap, camera, focus, spacing, and visual hierarchy instead of defaulting to a uniform row, column, stack, or grid. Panels and Actors may break, overlay, or span boundaries when that strengthens the presentation. Keep the reading flow unmistakable even when the page is asymmetric, layered, or non-linear. Use only as many meaningful panels as the scene needs, and do not force color or monochrome treatment.

scene.customText: Compose all actors confirmed present at the depicted time and place together, including quiet observers and non-human participants. Preserve established presence within a continuous scene unless departure is indicated. Widen the view or adjust spacing and depth to keep everyone distinguishable and interactions readable. Do not split the scene solely because of actor count, combine separate scenes, or add participants based only on mentions or candidate records.

presets.name: 기본
presets.instruction: Choose from visual flow, placement, action, gaze, environment, framing, crop, and negative space, never Actor count alone. If visible upper bodies align side by side as the main composition, choose sizeId 1. For parallel lying Actors, choose sizeId 1 when viewed from above; otherwise choose sizeId 2.

presets.name: 미지정
presets.instruction: Choose the sizeId that best fits the current illustration from the allowed candidates. Apply no additional aspect-ratio preference.
